title: PIPETTE: Prompt Injection Purple-Teaming for Robust LLM Agents
title_zh: PIPETTE：面向稳健 LLM 智能体的提示注入紫队测试
abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents routinely interact with untrusted external data, exposing them to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks that hijack agents into executing attacker-chosen tasks. To uncover these vulnerabilities at scale, automated red-teaming methods often leverage reinforcement learning (RL) to generate attacks that achieve high attack success rates (ASR). Model developers use the attacks discovered during internal red-teaming to harden agents through adversarial training before deployment, a collaborative offensive-defensive process known in cybersecurity as purple-teaming. However, we show that achieving high ASR during red-teaming does not guarantee robustness gains from subsequent adversarial training. Specifically, we find that two state-of-the-art RL-based red-teaming methods, RL-Hammer and PISmith, suffer from mode collapse, repeatedly discovering similar attack strategies whose additional successes add no additional robustness improvements to adversarial training. To address this gap, we introduce PIPETTE, a unified prompt injection purple-teaming framework that effectively converts red-teaming discoveries into defender robustness improvements. PIPETTE employs a dictionary learning-based reward that encourages broader coverage of attack strategies during red-teaming. It also integrates an on-policy adversarial training pipeline tailored to IPI defense, enabling agents to resist attacks while completing legitimate user tasks. Extensive evaluations across agentic benchmarks (AgentDojo and ASB) demonstrate that PIPETTE produces defenders that achieve near-zero attack success rates on static attacks and can withstand strong adaptive attacks, while maintaining benign task utility close to that of the undefended baseline.
abstract_zh: LLM 智能体在处理不可信的外部数据时，可能遭遇间接提示注入（indirect prompt injection，IPI），转而执行攻击者指定的任务。本文发现，自动化红队测试中的高攻击成功率（ASR）并不保证后续对抗训练能提升防御稳健性：RL-Hammer 和 PISmith 都出现了模式坍塌，反复发现相似的攻击策略，而这些额外的成功案例并未带来进一步的防御收益。为此，作者提出统一的紫队框架 PIPETTE，强调红队测试的策略覆盖，并结合面向 IPI 防御的同策略（on-policy）对抗训练，让智能体在抵御注入的同时继续完成合法用户任务。在 AgentDojo 和 ASB 上，训练后的智能体将静态攻击的成功率降至接近零，在强自适应攻击下也表现出较强的抵抗能力，同时在正常任务上的表现接近未加防御的基线。
key_points_zh: 攻击成功率衡量的是红队能否攻破智能体，而非这些案例能否为后续防御训练带来增益。
RL-Hammer 和 PISmith 出现模式坍塌：相似策略反复成功，却未进一步提升防御稳健性。
PIPETTE 将更广的策略覆盖与面向 IPI 防御的同策略对抗训练结合，兼顾防御与正常任务表现。
AgentDojo 和 ASB 的评估显示，静态攻击成功率接近零；模型在强自适应攻击下仍有较强抵抗能力，正常任务表现接近未防御基线。
